plan.summary: Record why six closed Windfall rows keep their label (no reported return multiple; model ranges straddle 1.5x or understate the run)

actions.oldValue: West Side Story (Palace Theatre, opened 2009-03-19, closed 2011-01-02). Press reports it recouped its $14 million capitalization, in September 2009.
actions.newValue: West Side Story (Palace Theatre, opened 2009-03-19, closed 2011-01-02). Press reports it recouped its $14 million capitalization, in September 2009. Stays Windfall (BRO-6559, checked 2026-10-29): the label rule moves a recouped show to Trickle only on a reported return multiple, and none is reported for this run. Our model (low data quality, weekly running cost estimated from show type) puts investors at 0.31x to 1.27x, but it also has the show barely past break-even at closing, while the press reported it recouped its $14 million about six months into a 22-month run. The model understates this run, so it is not used to relabel it.

actions.oldValue: In the Heights (Richard Rodgers Theatre, opened 2008-03-09, closed 2011-01-09). Press reports it recouped its $10 million capitalization, in January 2009.
